label: preparing
what: A coordinated catered community hospitality gathering/feast in the great hall at eighteen on day 1, with lanterns and 200 loaves. Initially not disclosed to me; I was later invited, but builder explicitly withheld the occasion's details until the event. Builder and innkeeper stocked the same bread chest; freight was involved in catering arrangements. Baker knowingly supplied feast bread, neighbour spread invitations, and secretary later knowingly arranged my attendance and escort. No evidence establishes the specific celebration, honouree, or that neighbour or secretary knows the withheld details.
